主要内容: TG Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: TGTX) presented long-term follow-up data from the Phase 2 and Open Label Extension (OLE) trial of ublituximab (TG-1101), its novel glycoengineered anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody, in relapsing forms of Multiple Sclerosis (RMS) at the American Academy of Neurology 71st Annual Meeting on May 7, 2019. The data showed that ublituximab is well tolerated with a median follow-up of 97.5 weeks. No patients discontinued treatment due to drug-related adverse events. AEs were infrequent during the OLE, with only 4 patients (9%) experiencing infusion-related reactions (IRRs), all Grade 1 or 2. The data support the ongoing Phase 3 ULTIMATE program, which is fully enrolled and expected to report results next year. TG Therapeutics is also developing umbralisib (TGR-1202) and other therapies for hematological malignancies and autoimmune diseases.
